subject: Renewal QBR & roadmap demo — coverage / exec window planning
messages:
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@clearmed.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@clearmed.com
Date: Thu, 14 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — propose coverage approach

Hi Stephanie,

As we get into renewal planning for ClearMed, our execs want a focused QBR that includes a short roadmap demo and a clear coverage plan for operations while key people travel that week.

Key constraints:
- Exec availability: Tue/Wed 10:00–12:00 PT (tight)
- Ops team can attend only in mornings (08:00–11:00 PT)
- We need a 45-minute demo + 30-minute Q&A + 15-minute executive highlight (90 minutes total)

Could Redwood propose a coverage approach so we don’t have to push the QBR if our Head of Ops is on site? A couple options we like: split the demo into two blocks (exec highlight + technical demo), or run with an ops backup and record a short handoff for those who miss the live session.

Attaching a draft agenda and our current stakeholder matrix.

Thanks — looking for your recommended approach and any alternate time blocks.

Maria
Director of Customer Success
ClearMed Health
Attachments: QBR_agenda_v2.pdf; Ops_coverage_matrix.xlsx
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@clearmed.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Sep 2028 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — propose coverage approach

Hi Maria — thanks for the context and the attachments. Good constraints to work with.

Two pragmatic plans from our side (short summary, we can pick one):

Plan A — Staggered split (recommended)
- 30 min Exec highlight (concise outcomes + ask) — schedule at 10:00 PT so execs join the start
- 45 min Technical roadmap demo — run 10:30–11:15 with ops present; include breakouts for advanced config
- 15 min Ops handoff & next steps — 11:15–11:30, recordable short clip for anyone missing 11:15 handoff
Pros: Execs see the top-level immediately; ops present for the demo section.
Cons: Short handoff may miss some detailed questions.

Plan B — Single block with ops backup (fallback)
- 90-minute contiguous slot 10:00–11:30 with Monica (CS) as ops backup who can answer runbook / access questions in the Q&A.
Pros: Single meeting, cleaner calendar.
Cons: Exec bandwidth constrained, ops absence risk if headcount unavailable.

Logistics and asks:
- Can you confirm whether ClearMed execs can commit to start-of-meeting attendance (10:00 PT)?
- If Plan A preferred, please confirm ops rep who MUST be present for the 10:30–11:15 demo.
- We’ll prepare a 3-slide exec highlight and a 10-minute pre-read doc for stakeholders.

I’ve looped in Monica (CS lead) for the runbook/backup and Karthik (solutions) for technical demo owners.

I’ll hold both Tue/Wed 10:00 PT slots tentatively and will share a brief run-of-show.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive — Renewals (Redwood Inference)
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@clearmed.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@clearmed.com
Date: Fri, 15 Sep 2028 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — propose coverage approach

Thanks, Stephanie — Plan A sounds closest to what we want. A couple of clarifications:

1) Execs will commit to being present at meeting start (10:00 PT) but may have to leave after the first 25–30 minutes for a conflict.
2) Ops backup today is Jorge Ramos (ops@clearmed.com); he will attend the 10:30 demo if needed but prefers a pre-read.

Next steps from our side: we’ll confirm Jorge as the primary ops attendee and share a short pre-read by Monday. Can Redwood prepare the 3-slide exec highlight and a 2-page demo pre-read?

Also, is there an option to record the 10:30–11:15 demo to share with our regional leads? That would be helpful.

—Maria
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@clearmed.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 16 Sep 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — propose coverage approach

Perfect — thanks for the confirmation. Quick logistics and commitments from our side: 

- We’ll run Plan A as the primary flow.
- Stephanie (me) will open at 10:00 PT with the 3-slide exec highlight. Monica will cover the runbook and ops impacts during the final 15 minutes.
- Karthik will lead the 45-minute technical demo 10:30–11:15 and we will record that segment and upload to the shared Drive link (see below).
- Jonas will own the recording & follow-up notes (timestamped Q&A).

Deliverables and deadlines:
- Redwood: 3-slide exec highlight (PDF) and 2-page demo pre-read — draft to you by Monday 09/18 COB.
- ClearMed: confirm Jorge Ramos as ops attendee and share any specific runbook items to surface by Monday 09/18 COB.

Shared drive (upload location): https://drive.redwood.com/shared/QBR/ClearMed/recordings
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4237 (I’ve added the meeting record and linked materials)

I’ll send a calendar invite for Tue 10/17 10:00–11:30 PT with a tentative agenda and recording consent checkbox. If anything changes, please flag asap.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive — Renewals (Redwood Inference)
